_note: SIMULATED DATA. These are plausible R&D technology intake requests constructed to exercise the model across its full disposition range. No real program, system, or scoring session is represented. Scores reflect one analyst's reading of the rubric anchors in gate/intake.py.

use_cases.title: Protocol deviation triage and severity pre-classification
use_cases.note: Deviations arrive as free text from sites and are hand-sorted before review. Volume is the constraint, not judgment.

use_cases.title: CRO contract term extraction into the vendor register
use_cases.note: Payment terms, change order thresholds, and termination clauses are keyed by hand from executed agreements.

use_cases.title: Literature screening for safety signal candidates
use_cases.note: Abstract-level screening ahead of full-text review. Recall matters far more than precision.

use_cases.title: Clinical study report patient narrative drafting
use_cases.note: First-draft narratives from structured subject data, edited by a writer before QC.

use_cases.title: Internal R&D policy and SOP question answering
use_cases.note: Staff ask where a procedure lives and what it requires. Currently a shared mailbox.

use_cases.title: Adverse event case coding to MedDRA preferred terms
use_cases.note: High volume, existing coded history available as labels, but the output lands in a regulated case record.

use_cases.title: Site feasibility questionnaire first-pass responses
use_cases.note: Repetitive sponsor questionnaires answered from prior submissions.

use_cases.title: Investigator brochure section drafting from source studies
use_cases.note: Synthesis across nonclinical and clinical sources into narrative sections.

use_cases.title: SOP change impact analysis across the document hierarchy
use_cases.note: When a parent SOP changes, identify every downstream document and training assignment affected.

use_cases.title: Governance board minutes and action item extraction
use_cases.note: Recorded governance meetings summarized into minutes and tracked actions.

use_cases.title: Target hypothesis generation from internal and public datasets
use_cases.note: Open-ended generation of candidate mechanisms for scientific review.

use_cases.title: Lab notebook semantic search across legacy archives
use_cases.note: Twenty years of scanned and typed notebooks with inconsistent structure.

use_cases.title: First-line review of informed consent form translations
use_cases.note: Reviewing vendor-supplied ICF translations before IRB submission. Appealing on its face and expensive to prove.
